scope: 11 unique sample assets; no catalog changes; no generations submitted

user_direction: 11 assets: Ember Tetra, Red Cherry Shrimp, one snail study, five named plants, two stones, one driftwood

assets.prompt_en: A single adult Ember Tetra (Hyphessobrycon amandae), slender laterally compressed orange amber body, small terminal mouth, dark natural eye, distinct dorsal, anal, paired pectoral and pelvic fins, small adipose fin and forked translucent caudal fin. Straight relaxed swimming pose facing +Z; fins separated and gently spread. Soft cartoon naturalism; believable proportions, gently rounded forms, restrained natural colors. No anthropomorphic face. Single isolated object; no scene, tank, ground, pot, pedestal, text or watermark. Neutral pose, separated anatomy, neutral light, no baked shadows.
morphology_acceptance: 侧扁细长体、尾柄与叉尾清楚
保留脂鳍及主要鳍，不新增霓虹横带
琥珀橙躯干与透明鳍边可区分

animation.rigging_risks: 躯干3–5节+尾柄/尾鳍，主要鳍独立控制；Tripo不保证可变形拓扑，需重拓扑与手工蒙皮，透明鳍不能焊成厚实体。

assets.prompt_en: A single adult Red Cherry Shrimp (Neocaridina davidi), red segmented curved abdomen, compact cephalothorax, short serrated rostrum, black eyes on short stalks, paired long antennae, anatomically distinct walking legs, underside swimmerets, and a spread but resting uropod tail fan. Neutral surface-resting pose facing +Z, all appendages separated; no eggs. Soft cartoon naturalism; believable proportions, gently rounded forms, restrained natural colors. No anthropomorphic face. Single isolated object; no scene, tank, ground, pot, pedestal, text or watermark. Neutral pose, separated anatomy, neutral light, no baked shadows.
morphology_acceptance: 额角、头胸甲、腹节与尾扇分开
步足/腹部游泳足/触须可辨，不能鱼鳍化
保持樱花虾轮廓，不做海虾巨螯

animation.rigging_risks: 腿、触须及尾扇细长易粘连/断裂；分组控制左右步足，腹节需尾弹弯曲；触须可曲线重建，不接受只有壳体平移。
